fork.name: PNW Pilot
fork.description: PNW Pilot is a personal 'Pacific Northwest' production distribution of openpilot, forked from xnor-tech/openpilot (which adds legacy Tesla HW1/HW2/HW3 'Raven' support) and driven daily on a Tesla Model S Raven and a Ford F-150 Lightning along the I-5/I-90 corridor. Its focus is chill-by-default longitudinal behavior — Conditional Experimental Switching with map+vision curve slowdowns, stock-ACC curve control (ICBM) on the Lightning, BluePilot-derived 4-signal Ford lateral — plus OSM/mapd services, a self-hosted upload/connect backend, and telemetry-driven per-car tuning. Every new toggle defaults OFF and panda safety is never weakened (one reviewed exception: the Ford 4-signal panda safety mode).

features.name: openpilot Longitudinal Control
features.description: openpilot controls gas and brake instead of the car's stock ACC. On many cars it is standard; on others it is an opt-in Alpha toggle (non-release branches). On the fork's F-150 Lightning it is the opt-in 'Alpha Long' A/B switch versus stock-ACC ICBM.

features.name: Experimental Mode
features.description: End-to-end driving mode that slows for curves, stop lights and stop signs. Requires openpilot longitudinal control, so per-car availability follows the oplong status of each car.

features.name: Automated Lane Centering
features.description: Continuous lane centering on all supported cars. Some models cannot steer below a minimum speed (noted per car).

features.name: Stop and Go
features.description: Follows traffic to a complete stop and resumes automatically. Cars with a minimum ACC speed or without resume-from-stop are noted per car.

features.name: Lane Change Assist
features.description: Steers through a lane change when the driver signals and nudges the wheel. See the separate nudgeless option for the no-nudge variant.

features.name: Driver Monitoring
features.description: Camera-based driver attention monitoring; always active. This fork keeps stock-strict defaults and layers optional glare and highway-timeout refinements on top.

features.name: Lebowski driving model (commaai-master port)
features.description: The fork ports commaai/master's modeld stack and the 'lebowski' driving model (combined supercombo, tinygrad-compiled, ~27 ms on a comma 3X) onto its line. Car-agnostic perception upgrade.

features.name: Upstream stability cherry-picks
features.description: Selected commaai/master fixes folded in without a full rebase: locationd/lagd timestamps, radar-lead probability filter, camerad driver-cam fixes, cruise-fault-not-silent, athena RPC.

features.name: ICBM — stock-ACC curve slowdown
features.description: When openpilot longitudinal is OFF, taps the car's own SET−/SET+ cruise buttons over CAN to steer the stock ACC set speed toward a curve target, then restores it. Concept invented by sunnypilot (Intelligent Cruise Button Management); PNW re-implements it for the F-150 Lightning only, gated on CESMode.

features.name: Green Light Alert
features.description: Ding + green banner when a held stop releases with no lead ('Light is green'), and a separate 'Car ahead is leaving' note when a close stopped lead departs. Core mechanics adopted from sunnypilot (with FrogPilot-informed lead handling); always on, no toggle.

features.name: 4-signal Ford lateral + hardened panda safety
features.description: BluePilot's validated 4-signal steer command (curvature + curvature rate + path offset + path angle) with matching custom panda safety, ported to the F-150 Lightning. Requires a panda reflash; capability-gated to the Lightning so Tesla safety stays byte-identical.

features.name: Ford lateral refinements
features.description: Predicted-curvature blend (fixes turn-exit wind-up), clean reset after a sustained manual turn, and BlueCruise blue-cluster display on engagement. Derived from BluePilot's Ford lateral work; stock-panda-safe; Lightning only in this fork.

features.name: Ford highway follow (LongitudinalExt)
features.description: BluePilot's follow-aware longitudinal shaping (gaining/pacing/trailing lead states) on the Lightning's openpilot-longitudinal path. Inert until the Alpha Longitudinal toggle is on.

features.name: CES — Conditional Experimental Switching
features.description: Chill mode by default, auto-switching to Experimental for upcoming curves (map + vision), stops, low speed and slow leads, with a 3-state on-screen button (CES/Chill/Exp). Independent implementation of FrogPilot's Conditional Experimental Mode concept; opt-in (CESMode, default OFF) and requires openpilot longitudinal.

features.name: Sharp-curve full-horizon + regen-coast
features.description: Scans the full ~500 m map horizon and lifts off the gas early so the curve entrance is the slowest point, using EV regen-style coasting (~0.2 g) instead of friction braking unless a genuinely sharp curve needs more. Rides the CES master toggle.

features.name: Lightning per-car curve penalty
features.description: The F-150 Lightning slows more for curves than the Tesla — a field-calibrated speed-dependent 'hump' (up to ~5 mph at 45–62 mph) plus extra margin on downhill and left-hand curves, because its EPS is physically weaker. Lightning only.

features.name: Standstill latch
features.description: CES never adopts Chill at 0 mph, so launches from a standstill behind a close lead are model-governed instead of a hard MPC launch. Fixes stop-and-go 'horse bucking' and red-light jolts.

features.name: Red-light stop-hold guards
features.description: The stop reason keeps governing even with a creeping lead present, and a standstill hold blocks the Experimental-to-Chill exit at ~0 mph — preventing the red-light lurch toward set speed. Internal CES logic.

features.name: Stop-intent fast path + evidence-gated pull-away
features.description: An absolute fast path into Experimental on model stop-intent, with a guarded exception that lets the car follow a lead genuinely pulling away below the red-light floor. Internal CES logic.

features.name: Twisty-descent base trim
features.description: On a packed sequence of descending curves, holds a lower base cruise through the section instead of surging back to full set speed between blind curves. Flat twisty roads keep full speed. Rides the CES master.

features.name: Highway speed-limit floor
features.description: Curve speed control never trims below the posted highway limit read from mapd, bounding the downside of aggressive curve tuning.

features.name: Rain slowdown
features.description: Driver-selected wet-weather margin subtracted from curve targets (Light ≈3 mph, Heavy ≈5 mph), applied identically on both cars. RainMode toggle, default off.

features.name: CES2 decision core (shadow)
features.description: A redesigned CES decision core with graded stop urgency and precedence rules. Runs shadow-only: it logs telemetry while CES v1 still makes every decision. Ces2Core toggle, default OFF.

features.name: Blind-spot gate (Tesla Raven)
features.description: Reads Tesla Raven blind-spot state from the AutopilotStatus 0x399 message, logged and available to block nudgeless lane changes into an occupied lane. Raven-specific; walk-by flip test still pending per the fork's docs.

features.name: Glare desensitization (DM)
features.description: Keeps driver monitoring in its active mode through low-sun/windshield glare bursts instead of dropping to passive wheel-touch nagging — higher pose-uncertainty threshold, fast reset, face-loss grace. Always on (ungated).

features.name: Road-gated DM timeout selector
features.description: 3-way DmMode selector: Default (stock strict), Highway (relaxed cadence only on freeways/divided roads), Relaxed. Monitoring is never off; default is stock-strict.

features.name: Configurable DM tiers (device-local)
features.description: Shipped timeout magnitudes stay strict in source; personal longer values live only in a device-local /data/pnw/dm.json set via a CLI (clamped 10 s–4 h). The Relaxed tier is hidden in the UI unless unlocked.

features.name: PNW maps default + auto-download
features.description: Default OSM coverage is WA/OR/ID and the first map download auto-arms on a fresh install — no settings fiddling for Pacific Northwest use.

features.name: Get map for this location
features.description: On-demand OSM region download for the area under the current GPS position, with a covered/greyed indicator for trips outside the default states.

features.name: mapd binary persistence
features.description: Installs the mapd Go binary to persistent /data/mapd outside the git tree, so auto-update's git clean can no longer silently delete it and kill map data.

features.name: Happening Ahead overlay
features.description: One display-only daemon merges police reports, highway rest areas and EV DC-fast chargers into a right-side overlay for long corridor drives. Master toggle LocationServicesEnabled, default ON.

features.name: Police alerts (Waze-sourced)
features.description: Waze-parity police alerts: live distance, clears when passed, drops other-side and stale reports, banner only inside 0.25 mi, no siren. The feed defaults to a keyless caching proxy (AWS Lambda) with fallback to a device-local key; poll errors are surfaced in red instead of a false 'Clear'.

features.name: EV charger hints
features.description: DC-fast chargers (and optionally Level 2 via EvIncludeLevel2, default OFF) in the overlay, with compass direction, near-field roadside handling, and slow-L2 suppression when a DC-fast is within 5 miles.

features.name: Corridor rest-area previews
features.description: Stable 15-mile rest-area previews keyed by corridor identity (I-5/I-90/I-82/US-12/US-95), shipped as curated JSON because OSM tiles strip these POIs.

features.name: Self-hosted upload gateway + connect
features.description: Drives upload to the owner's AWS S3 bucket via a presigned-PUT API gateway instead of comma connect; pairing QR and connect URLs point at the self-hosted endpoint. API_HOST is pinned so uploads can't silently fall back and be lost.

features.name: Upload at home while charging + no silent data loss
features.description: HD/rlog uploads may run even while onroad when on a priority (home, geo-gated) WiFi — so an EV charging at home still gets its best upload window — and the last hard upload failure is surfaced on screen instead of dropped silently.

features.name: Two-pass upload + HD interleave
features.description: Pass 1 uploads small files (qlog/qcamera) on any network; pass 2 uploads HD video and rlog only on real non-metered WiFi and offroad, with an HD file forced after every N small uploads so video is never starved.

features.name: Upload-phase indicators
features.description: CONNECT logo turns green during pass-1 log uploads and blue during pass-2 HD uploads, with live Mbps shown; clears within ~0.5 s of a WiFi drop.

features.name: Defer HD Video Upload
features.description: Optional toggle that holds camera video uploads while qlog/rlog/qcamera still flow, keeping scarce WiFi for logs. Default OFF.

features.name: Device locator
features.description: The uploader self-reports its LAN IP on each upload request (logged server-side), making the roaming device findable via CloudWatch.

features.name: Perpetual tethering + priority WiFi + geo-gate
features.description: Keeps the device hotspot up and auto-joins known priority networks only near saved home locations, for reliable connectivity without manual switching.

features.name: Captive-portal auto-accept
features.description: Automatically walks known click-through WiFi TOS portals (MikroTik variants) so uploads work behind guest networks; never blocks LTE or tethering.

features.name: LTE throttle guard + NAT fix
features.description: Recovers a throttled or stuck LTE data session and adds iptables masquerade so tethered clients get internet.

features.name: Auto-recalibrate on car swap
features.description: When the device is moved to a different car, the learned car-specific calibration and live-tune params are cleared automatically before CarParams publish — no manual Reset Calibration. Same-car reboots are untouched.

features.name: Fingerprint hardening
features.description: Never persists a MOCK fingerprint over a known-good car, adds a fleet-identity fallback so an OTA can't drop the fingerprint, and fixes a poisoned firmware-cache dashcam-after-toggle failure mode.

features.name: card crash resilience
features.description: The manager restarts the car-interface process if it crashes (same policy as the UI) and logs fatal crashes before dying, so a crash can't silently strand a drive.

features.name: Dark-cockpit CES overlay + 3-state button
features.description: A tiered on-road cockpit card with health dots, a standstill diagnostic dump, the live 3-state CES button, and a Hide-CES-Debug toggle.

features.name: Right-side context indicators
features.description: Lightning-specific silent-when-healthy indicators: CALIBRATING x% (why it won't engage after a swap), STEER: STOCK / NO 4SIG PANDA (lateral fallback or panda-flash mismatch), and RAIN −N (wet-weather margin armed).

features.name: Confidence ball
features.description: A comma-4-style ball on the right edge showing the model's own confidence in the current plan (teal high / amber mid / red low). Display-only.

features.name: LONG MISMATCH warning
features.description: A red warning flagging the dangerous state where Alpha Longitudinal was toggled ON but the running session is still in shadow because persistent CarParams lag a session.

features.name: Auto-update self-deploy channels
features.description: The device is a git checkout tracking the fork's channel branches with the stock updater (fetch also runs onroad); opendbc/panda ride as SHA-pinned submodules and persistence guards stop a reboot from reverting an install.

features.name: Vision Turn Speed Control
features.description: Caps cruise speed in curves from the model's predicted path curvature, decel-limited and smooth. Lineage: Move Fast team's VisionTurnController (imported by sunnypilot); PNW's own implementation rides the CES master toggle and requires openpilot longitudinal.

features.name: Map turn speed control (map-curve braking)
features.description: Folds pfeiferj-mapd OSM curve target speeds into VTSC so the car brakes for blind curves beyond camera sight. VtscMapCurves toggle, ON by default; requires openpilot longitudinal.

features.name: OSM data via pfeiferj mapd
features.description: Ships pfeiferj/mapd v2 (Go) for OpenStreetMap speed limits, road names and curve speeds, feeding the speed-limit display and map-curve braking.

features.name: Legacy Tesla (HW1/HW2/HW3 Raven) support
features.description: Inherited from xnor-tech: pre-2021 Tesla Model S/X support via a dedicated tesla_legacy panda safety mode, legacy CAN builder, Continental/Bosch radar handling and external/multi-panda integration. The fork's primary car (Model S Raven HW3) runs on this.

features.name: Road name + speed limit display
features.description: Shows the current road name and posted speed limit from mapd/OSM on screen (ShowRoadName / ShowSpeedLimit).

features.name: Nudgeless lane change
features.description: Lane change without a steering nudge once the blinker is on (timed hold). Common community feature; in this fork it is an opt-in toggle wired for the Tesla Raven and F-150 Lightning, default OFF.

features.name: No disengage on brake
features.description: Would keep openpilot engaged through a brake tap. The toggle exists but is marked unsupported and greyed out in this fork's params — effectively not functional.
